issues.description: The problem statement (UML and textual description) specifies that Milkable.messageOnMilk() returns a boolean (and even states it should return true/false depending on success), but the provided solution implements Milkable.messageOnMilk() as returning a String (and Seal/Goat return Strings). This return-type mismatch will confuse students about the required signature and behavior of messageOnMilk() and may cause compilation or test failures if they follow the problem text instead of the solution.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the specification and the template consistent: either change the problem statement/UML/text to specify that messageOnMilk() returns a String (and describe its expected message format), or change the solution and implementations to have messageOnMilk() return a boolean and adjust usages accordingly. Preferably update the problem statement to expect a String return (matching the solution examples) or explicitly state which return type students should implement.
